summary: REQ-1/2/3 appear implemented: Dashboard first summary card is replaced with a "Monthly Target" card in the existing 5-card grid, its value is computed via a shared monthly-target utility consistent with GoalCard, formatted to 2 decimals with global currency symbol logic, and styled with a left Repeat icon and `text-monthly-target` coloring. However, the diff also includes several unrelated UI/layout/animation changes not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed various GoalCard layout/compression and alignment behaviors (e.g., removed min-height constraint, reduced spacing, h-full stretching, mt-auto alignment) beyond what was required (only the first dashboard summary card was to be replaced).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrained changes to replacing the first summary card and adding the aggregate calculation; it also states not to redesign other cards/layout beyond what is necessary.

hallucinated_features.description: Added staggered entrance animations (fade-in/unblur with sequential delays) for goals/rows and additional grid/container alignment tweaks (e.g., `items-stretch`) that are not part of the requested Monthly Target summary card replacement.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not mentioned in requirements; could be considered a redesign/behavior change beyond necessary scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced or expanded CSS/theme changes (OKLCH color system, manual light mode overrides, removed `.card-min-height`, new/updated progress bar expired styling) not requested for this task.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not required by REQ-1/2/3 and potentially affects broader UI beyond the first summary card replacement.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified GoalTable/CreateGoalForm/EditGoalDialog behavior and UI (sorting, quick add button, layout changes, optional deadline toggle support, etc.) beyond the requested dashboard summary card change.
hallucinated_features.reason: These areas are outside the specified change (Dashboard first summary card + aggregate calculation).
